facts.activity_file: handing back a partially completed isolation

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: controlled removal of isolation and return to service
mechanical support of a load during maintenance access

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: unplanned release of kinetic energy at P-9503

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on P-9503, M-9503 and PT-9503 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. P-9503 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during routine operation while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 7 February 2015 a hazard report was recorded on P-9503, M-9503 and PT-9503 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during routine operation; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
